Look at the periapsis entry in the infobox: `| periapsis = {{gaps |362 |600}} km
({{gaps |356 |400}}–{{gaps |370 |400}} km)` So the minimum perigee value on the Wikipedia page for the Moon is **356,400 km**! (356 400 km). Now let's check Eliud Kipchoge's record-making marathon pace on his Wikipedia page or world record marathon time. Wait, let's fetch Kipchoge's full personal bests or marathon world record details from his Wikipedia page wikitext. Let's run a curl command to inspect Kipchoge's infobox and world record sections.```python cmd = """curl -s -A "Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64)" "https://en.wikipedia.org/w/api.php?action=query&prop=revisions&rvprop=content&format=json&titles=Eliud_Kipchoge" | python3 -c "import sys, json; data=json.load(sys.stdin); wt=list(data['query']['pages'].values())[0]['revisions'][0]['*']; print([line for line in wt.splitlines() if 'marathon' in line.lower() or 'record' in line.lower()][:30])" """ out = await run_command(cmd) print(out) ```
